description: Update merchant settings: discount stacking mode, cap, the store's terms for wallets sent without proof of control, and stablecoin payment configuration. All fields optional; supplied fields replace their current values. discountCap is a whole number from 1 to 100. A wallet with proof gets the full discount their holdings earn, without the daily limit for unproven buyers. Owner only.

discountCap.description: Maximum total discount percentage: a whole number from 1 to 100, no decimals

discountMode.description: 'highest' uses best single discount, 'stack' adds them together, 'capped' stacks up to discountCap

maxDiscountsPerWalletPerDay.description: Discount codes per UTC day for a wallet without proof of control; null = no limit

maxUnprovenDiscount.description: Most a wallet without proof of control can get, in percent: 0 = no discount, null = the same as a proven wallet

usdcPayment.description: USDC payment settings, or null to disable

name: insumer_configure_settings

data.description: The endpoint's payload: a signed attestation, trust profile, discount, merchant or token records

error.description: Error details when ok is false

items.description: The result when the endpoint returns a JSON array

message.description: A plain-text result (insumer_setup), or a message from the API

meta.description: Response metadata such as version and timestamp

ok.description: true when the API call succeeded

title: Update merchant settings
